keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (no Cliopatria row; the 299-849 Maya envelope covers Yaxhá). The page says the city 'controlled an estimated territory of 237 square kilometres (92 sq mi)'; a 10 km disc resolves to one 253 km2 cell (ratio 1.07). The Late Preclassic extent 'the largest settlement in the Yaxha-Sacnab basin' is not mapped; soft.

region.text: Yaxhá (Petén Department): 'controlled an estimated territory of 237 square kilometres', one 253 km2 grid cell

ledger.note: Middle Preclassic: 'the first settlement being founded sometime in the Middle Preclassic period (c. 1000-350 BC)'; 'In the Late Preclassic the city became the largest settlement in the Yaxha-Sacnab basin'. The year -350 is the end of the Middle Preclassic range, a bridge.

region.text: Yaxhá (Petén Department): 'controlled an estimated territory of 237 square kilometres', one 253 km2 grid cell

ledger.note: 710: 'In 710, king K'ak' Tiliw Chan Chaak of Naranjo sacked Yaxha, captured its king and sacrificed him'; the page has Yaxhá 'eclipsed during the Late Classic (c. AD 600-900) by neighbouring Naranjo'. Treated as dependency; the page does not say tribute or rule.

region.text: Yaxhá (Petén Department): 'controlled an estimated territory of 237 square kilometres', one 253 km2 grid cell

ledger.note: 799: Naranjo's king 'went to war against Yaxha and its allies in AD 799' and captured K'inich Lakamtuun, Yaxhá's king, which shows a Yaxhá independent of Naranjo; bridge.

region.text: Yaxhá (Petén Department): 'controlled an estimated territory of 237 square kilometres', one 253 km2 grid cell

ledger.note: About 900: 'The city survived well into the Terminal Classic (c. 800-900) but was abandoned by the Postclassic period (c. 900-1525)'; 'There is no evidence of the rapid collapse of the Yaxha polity'. Infobox 'Abandoned: Terminal Classic'.

wars.name: Naranjo's wars on Yaxha
wars.outcome: 710: Naranjo sacked Yaxhá, captured and sacrificed its king; 799: Naranjo's war on Yaxhá 'and its allies' captured K'inich Lakamtuun. No land change is stated.
wars.note: The Naranjo page has 'the defeat of Yaxha in 710' and 'Itzamnaaj K'awiil ... fought against Yaxha'.

certainty.note: The page gives an area (237 km2) but no frontier.

sources.title: Yaxha
sources.note: First settlement Middle Preclassic; largest in the basin in the Late Preclassic; eclipsed by Naranjo; sacked 710; war 799; Terminal Classic survival; territory 237 km2.

notes:
NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no Yaxhá row; the 299-849 envelope covers it (the -247 shape lies on the Peten core). Only two dated political events are on the page (710 and 799); the state's start and end are bridges (period ranges). Infobox area check: 237 km2 on the page against one 253 km2 cell.
COUNTERPARTS. Naranjo is written in this batch. The page's claim that Yaxhá 'peaked in the Early Classic ... following Teotihuacan's decisive intervention at Tikal in AD 378' is not entered (relationship to Tikal not stated).
